Maya Chen: Hey all — quick follow-up from today's all-hands on sales/GTM/partners. Posting the Q&A thread so leadership can answer asynchronously. TL;DR: pipeline momentum, partner enablement, and asks for cross-team blockers. Ask 1: what's the near-term product ask to unblock 2 deals? Ask 2: timeline for partner portal? Drop short questions below or add follow-ups. Recording + slides linked below. :point_down:

Jose Kim: Thanks — can we get the list of the top 3 deals that need product input? Want to prioritize SE time and avoid context switching.

Ruth Li: Also — comms for partner renewals: when do we re-align quotas? A few reps flagged carryover concerns.

Samir Patel: Partnerships update: in NDA with two ISVs, pilot with Datacomp next week. Partner portal ETA is end of Q2 but we can do early access for strategic partners. I'll publish partner-specific ask cards tomorrow.

Diane Park: Quick roadmap clarification: partner portal MVP (onboarding + SSO + billing hooks) targeted for 2026-06-15. For the product block on Deal-X, we can prioritize a small API change; need a one-page spec by Friday to scope. Ping me for a 30m deep dive.

Alex Rivera: High-level direction: focus on three priorities — 1) close near-term enterprise pilots, 2) partner enablement for key vendor integrations, 3) stabilize Dedicated SLAs. We'll allocate a small product SWAT team for the top two blockages. Happy to join customer calls if that speeds things up.

Jose Kim: Proposal: SEs file requests into #eng-runtime with label `allhands-ask` and include customer impact + timeline. That will make prioritization easier.

OpsBot: Recording and slides uploaded -> https://redwood.app/rec/1791234567. (slides: https://redwood.app/slides/1791234567) :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Great — next steps summary: Samir to publish partner ask cards by EOD tomorrow; Diane to post the product spec link and ETA; Jose to collect top 3 deals and SE impact notes by COB tomorrow; Alex to confirm SWAT team owners by Monday. If anyone else has blockers, add them here. :pray:

Ruth Li: Quick follow-up: will quota policy changes require manager + finance signoff? Reps need clarity before next week's renewals.

Alex Rivera: Short answer: permanent quota changes go through Sales Ops + Finance; temporary carryover exceptions can be approved by me + Head of Sales (Maya). We'll publish the official policy doc early next week.

Samir Patel: Sharing pilot partner list and initial success metrics in #partnerships now. cc @Maya Chen

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — closing the thread for asynchronous followups. If something urgent, ping @Maya Chen directly.
